data.name: Race 'n Dash
data.detailed_description:
Race ’n Dash is a fast-paced arcade racing game packed with variety. Zip through 10 unique tracks, master drift challenges, and try crazy modes like bowling or traffic-dodging. Choose from 20 distinctive vehicles, race solo, split-screen, or test your skills in speedruns, drifts, and more. Quick rounds, tons of modes, endless fun.

Race 'n Dash has many unique modes ensuring fun for hours:

  • Speedrun Mode - Drive as fast as you possibly can! Your objective get the fastest time. Mode has no opponents.

  • 1v1 - A real competition indeed! Race with an opponent that has the same car as you.

  • Drift - Turns your car into a true drift machine! Perfect for doing tricks and lapping the track.

  • 'n Dash - Swerve through traffic at high speeds. You get more points if you do risky moves.

  • Driving Classes - Go and advance through classes, while racing, drifting, speeding. Great way to earn points and level up. Prizes are awaiting you!

  • Drifting Practice - Train your skills on 3 unique maps designed for you to learn to control your car without crashing into a barrier.

  • Testing Grounds - Huge map with many activities, playground for everyone. Learn, explore, try, or just have fun, it's up to you. Great way to find out limits of your cars, best tune or practice drifting without drift mode. On this map, sky's the limit.

  • Bowling - Tired of going around the track? Ram the car into bowling pins and get strikes.

  • Split-Screen - Grab 2 controllers and challenge your friend to a 1v1. Customise your battle as you wish. Great fun for friends!

  • Ski Jumping - Have you ever wanted to fly a car? Well... now you can! Jump as far away as you can and test aerodynamics of a car.

Race 'n Dash has 10 normal tracks + 3 drift practice.

10 Normal Track:

  • The Desert - Short, simple, sweet and fun for beginners! Filled with sand and rocks.

  • Hi-Speed Forest - Enjoy high speeds, easy corners and beauty of nature!

  • Fast City - Beautiful cityscape and flat roads... What more could you ask for?

  • Icy Roads - Snowy and beautiful. Perfect harmony of speed and turns.

  • Canyon Roadside - Rocky, brown and fast. Beautiful landscape.

  • Cozy Village - Enjoy the stay... and quite the tricky turns.

  • Lava Track - Feel the heat and tight angles when cornering.

  • Candyland - Sweet 'n sour at the same time. Don't let it fool you...

  • Mountain Ring - Simple, fast and fun! What more could you ask for?

  • Dark Swamp - Dark, creepy and radioactive. Don't stay here too long!

3 Drift Only:

  • Blooming Forest - Crazy turns, X-Shape and crazy potential for huge angle.

  • Island Docks - High speed, high angle, space for burnouts. All surrounded in a cityscape.

  • Canyon Airstrip - Great variety, two opposite sections, all covered in sand.

The varieity of vehicles is simply huge. 20 Fully unique and stylized vehicles for you to experience.

  • The Transporter (2008) – Legendary diesel hauler.

  • AveJo City (1990) – Vintage charm, boxy classic.

  • AveJo Vectral (2015) – Sleek, tech-forward urban ride.

  • BVM 5M 90F (2018) – Aggressive design, pure speed.

  • Amdza XR7 (1994) – Aerodynamic 90s street icon.

  • Auto SR7 (2020) – Luxury coupe, performance focus.

  • Nightin RT-G (2009) – Twin-turbo sports powerhouse.

  • BVM 4Z (2025) – Electric roadster, eco-performance.

  • Sunqi 777 (1989) – Classic speed machine, aerodynamic.

  • Speedia R51 (2006) – Lightweight turbo sports car.

  • Fleet Horse (2016) – Stylish, powerful modern muscle.

  • ABC GTR (2019) – Track-ready engineering marvel.

  • Ferrite RB02 (2022) – Handcrafted elegance, exclusivity.

  • Chemullet Damascus (2008) – Muscle meets tech.

  • Evasion Discharge (2020) – Supercharged V8 beast.

  • Ferrite Milan (2020) – Italian-inspired grand tourer.

  • CyberVehicle (2024) – Armored electric futuristic ride.

  • M-Desert Vision (2020) – Luxury EV for dunes.

  • Speedster (2025) – Sleek electric performance icon.

  • SuperSpeed Blox (2025) – Blocky EV with insane power.

This game has many more unique things for you. Play the game and find out for yourself! I made it as a solo developer and it took me over a year. Made with Love in Poland.
